app.name: MingldIngl
gate.tagline: No swiping. Speak, keep your word, and the faces are earned.
phone.title: Prove your number
phone.why: Your number is your sigil. One per person, never shown to anyone.
phone.label: Phone number
phone.cost: We text a six-digit code to this number. It costs you nothing.
verify.title: Speak the code
verify.sentTo: A six-digit code is on its way to {{phone}}. It lives ten minutes.
verify.expiredBody: Codes last ten minutes and allow five tries. Ask for a new one.
onboarding.nameTitle: What does the hold call you?
onboarding.nameHint: Your first name only. Seek never shows it — only those you bond with, or meet in the Square.
onboarding.genderMaleHint: You will be shown to women.
onboarding.genderFemaleHint: You will be shown to men.
onboarding.photosHint: At least three, up to six. Your first stays sealed until you have truly talked.
onboarding.bornInvalid: Enter the day, month and year you were born.
onboarding.bioRequired: Write a few lines in your own words.
onboarding.cityRequired: Pick the place you call home.
photos.uploadFailed: The portrait did not arrive. Tap to try again.
photos.permissionDenied: Allow access to your photos to choose your portraits.
photos.removeBody: It leaves your character at once. You can add another any time.
onboarding.aboutHint: A few lines in your own words. Others read it before they see your face.
onboarding.oathHint: What do you seek? Those who seek the same are shown to you first.
oath.BondHint: A partner to build a life with.
onboarding.welcomeTitle: Your tale is written in full.
city.title: Where do you live?
city.locationDenied: Location is off. Pick the city you call home.
city.noMatch: No place called “{{query}}”. Try another spelling.
closed.suspendedBody: The keepers have closed your gate after a report. If you think this is wrong, write to them.
closed.deletedBody: Its portraits and letters were burned. A new tale needs a new beginning at the Gate.
closed.updateBody: A newer version is needed to cross the gate.
closed.maintenanceTitle: The gate is shut for repairs
closed.maintenanceBody: The keepers are mending the hold. It opens again shortly.
points.label: {{points}} points
edit.photosHint: Hold a portrait to lift it, then tap where it goes. The first is your sealed portrait.
state.offlineBody: No connection. We will carry on when the road returns.
error.network: No connection — check your network and try again.
error.profile.born: Enter the day, month and year you were born.
error.profile.name: Enter your name.
error.profile.city: Pick a place from the list.
error.profile.gender: Choose one of the offered options.
error.profile.oath: Choose one of the three oaths.
error.photos.not_image: That photo could not be read.
error.photos.full: You already have the most portraits allowed.
error.photos.min: Add another portrait before removing this one.
error.auth.verification_expired: This code is too old — send a new one.
error.auth.provider_unavailable: Verification is unavailable, try again shortly.
error.signups.closed: New sign-ups are closed for now.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries — wait a minute.
welcome.codexHint: How the hold keeps its word
seek.restsBody: Your candles are spent for tonight. The hold lights new ones at dawn.
seek.fullBody: {{count}} bonds already burn. Keep your word to them, or close one, before you summon another.
seek.emptyBody: No one new walks the road tonight. The hold sends new faces each day.
seek.closedBody: The keepers have shut the doors for a while. Your bonds still burn.
quests.embersBanner: {{name}} waits for your word. {{hours}} hours before the fire dies.
quests.emptyBody: Summon a companion in the Tavern. Every bond you keep is written here.
bond.newBodyHer: Whoever speaks first earns the first deed. Her portrait stays sealed until you have both spoken {{n}} times.
bond.newBodyHis: Whoever speaks first earns the first deed. His portrait stays sealed until you have both spoken {{n}} times.
bond.seal1: The seal broke — a first portrait is yours.
bond.seal2: The seal broke — a second portrait is yours.
bond.seal3: The seal broke — a third portrait, and the district, are yours.
bond.seal4: The last seal broke — every portrait is yours.
bond.embers: {{name}} wrote {{ago}} hours ago. In {{left}} hours the fire dies, and the silence is yours.
bond.coldTheirs: The fire went out. No one wrote for two days after your turn — the silence was theirs, so you lose nothing.
bond.coldMine: The fire went out. Your turn passed in silence for two days, and the hold took its due.
bond.severedBody: The letters are closed. Neither of you can summon the other again.
bond.fadedBody: No one spoke for a week, so the fire went out on its own. No one is at fault.
bond.sendFailed: The letter would not send. Try again.
bond.optSealsHint: What each seal reveals, and when
bond.optShareHint: Send the plan to a friend before you meet
bond.optCastOutHint: Block — they never see you again
bond.optSeverHint: Close the letters for both of you
bond.sealsBody: Each seal breaks when you have both written enough letters: {{s1}} each for the first portrait, {{s2}} for the second, {{s3}} for the third and the district, {{s4}} for everything.
bond.severBody: The letters close for both of you, and neither can summon the other again. No one loses points.
bond.castOutBody: They never see you again, and you never see them. The bond is severed.
companion.nextSeal: Seal {{n}} breaks when you have both written {{at}} letters.
companion.allSeals: Every seal is broken. Nothing of them is hidden now.
ceremony.sealTitle3Her: A third portrait, and her district
ceremony.sealTitle3His: A third portrait, and his district
ceremony.sealBody: {{n}} letters each. The next seal breaks at {{next}}.
ceremony.sealBodyLast: {{n}} letters each. Nothing is sealed between you now.
ceremony.bondBody: You and {{name}}. Speak first, and the first seal will start to crack.
ceremony.dawnTitle: Seven dawns — the bonus is yours
ceremony.dawnBody: Seven dawns. The fire is proud of you.
tierCeremony.Opal: More candles each night. The first light is yours.
tierCeremony.Amethyst: Deeper portraits. The road opens wider.
tierCeremony.Sapphire: More candles still. The hold knows your name.
tierCeremony.Ruby: Candles to spare. The fire inside you never goes out.
deed.reply: A word was answered in kind
deed.seventhDawn: Seven dawns — the bonus is yours
deed.goneCold: A silence fell, and the hold took its due
deed.penalised: The keepers judged a report against you
deeds.emptyBody: Every point you earn or lose is written here.
character.ascentHint: The gems, and what each one opens
report.notWhoTheyClaim: Not who they claim to be
report.sentBody: The keepers read every report. Nothing happens to anyone’s score until a keeper decides.
gate.lede: Those you cast out never see you, and you never see them.
gate.emptyTitle: No one waits at the gate
gate.emptyBody: You have cast no one out.
push.title: May we ring for you?
push.body: Only for letters, bells, and fires going cold — never for adverts.
error.seek.no_candles: Your candles are spent for tonight.
error.seek.fire_full: Your fire is full. Close a bond before you summon another.
error.seek.their_fire_full: Their fire is full tonight. Try another.
error.seek.closed: The tavern is closed for now.
error.account.suspended: This character has been cast out.
step.icebreaker.title: Break the ice
step.icebreaker.body: Answer one question each. You see both answers together.
step.icebreakerSealed.title: Your answer is sealed
step.trial.title: Take the Trial
step.trial.body: Five questions. See how alike you are.
step.trialSealed.title: Your Trial is sealed
step.trialSealed.body: The result opens when you have both finished.
step.rite.title: Light the Flame Rite
step.rite.body: Five minutes, face to face, before you pledge to meet.
step.riteAsked.title: {{name}} asks for the Flame Rite
step.riteAsked.body: Five minutes, face to face. You can say no.
step.riteMine.title: The Rite is asked for
step.riteAgreed.title: Step into the Rite
step.riteAgreed.body: You both agreed. Light the fire when you are ready.
step.meeting.title: Choose a meeting
step.meeting.body: Verified places, chosen for a first meeting.
step.meetingTheirs.title: {{name}} pledged to meet
step.meetingTheirs.body: {{where}}. Pledge too, and the meeting is sworn.
step.meetingMine.title: Your pledge is given
step.meetingSworn.title: The meeting is sworn
step.attendance.title: Did {{name}} come?
step.rate.title: How was {{venue}}?
step.rate.body: Only people who met there can rate it.
icebreaker.hint: You will see {{name}}’s answer only after you both answer.
icebreaker.sealedBody: {{name}} has not answered yet. Both answers open together.
icebreaker.reward: {{points}}  The ice broke between two strangers. The Flame Rite is open to you.
icebreaker.rewardNoRite: {{points}}  The ice broke between two strangers.
trial.sealedBody: {{name}} has not finished yet. The result opens when you both have.
rite.proposeBody: Five minutes, face to face, before you pledge to meet. Both must agree; either can douse the fire at any moment.
rite.notStored: Calls are not recorded or stored.
rite.askedBody: Five minutes, face to face. You can say no — the letters go on either way.
rite.readyBody: The five minutes start when you are both in the light.
rite.doneBody: You have seen each other. Now you can pledge to meet.
rite.reward: {{points}}  Two faces met across the glass
call.connectingBody: Waiting for {{name}} to step into the light.
call.lostBody: The fire lost its air. Try again — the five minutes start over.
call.douseBody: The Rite ends for both of you. You can light it again later.
call.permission: The Rite needs your camera and microphone.
meeting.whereBody: Verified places, chosen for a first meeting: public, warm, easy to leave.
meeting.noPlaces: No places are kept near you yet.
meeting.theyPledged: {{name}} has pledged. Pledge too, and the meeting is sworn.
meeting.choose: Choose the day and the hour.
meeting.promise: A sworn meeting is a promise. Not coming without a word leaves a scar.
meeting.swornBody: {{when}}, {{venue}}. Tell a friend where you will be.
meeting.reward: {{points}}  A meeting was sworn under open sky
meeting.calledOffBody: {{name}} is told at once. No one loses anything.
venue.goneBody: The keepers took it from the list. Choose another for your meeting.
attendance.body: {{when}}, {{venue}}. Your answer is private; it only matters if it keeps happening.
attendance.metHint: The encounter is kept — for you both.
rate.title: How was {{venue}}?
rate.body: Only people who met there can rate it.
deed.icebreaker: The ice broke between two strangers
deed.rite: Two faces met across the glass
deed.meeting: A meeting was sworn under open sky
deed.oathProven: Your oath was proven by two kept meetings
error.icebreaker.closed: The icebreaker has not opened yet.
error.trial.closed: The Trial has not opened yet.
error.rite.proposed: The Rite is already asked for.
error.rite.wait: Give them time before you ask again.
error.rite.not_asked: No one has asked for the Rite.
error.rite.not_agreed: Both must agree to the Rite first.
error.video.unavailable: The Rite cannot be lit right now.
error.video.off: The Flame Rite is not offered.
error.meeting.seal: Write more letters before you choose a meeting.
error.meeting.rite: Complete the Flame Rite before you pledge to meet.
error.meeting.venue_gone: This place is gone — choose another.
error.meeting.time: Choose a time from two hours to thirty days from now.
error.meeting.sworn: A meeting is already sworn — call it off first.
error.meeting.not_open: That meeting is no longer open.
error.venue.not_kept: Only a kept meeting can rate its place.
war.pauseHint: Hidden from Seek; your bonds go on
war.soundHint: Plays on events, never over the silent switch
war.notificationsHint: Letters, bells, and fires going cold
war.codexHint: How the hold keeps its word
war.signOutHint: Leave this phone; your character stays
signOut.title: Sign out of this phone?
signOut.body: Your character, bonds and letters stay. Coming back means a new code to this number.
sigil.title: Change your sigil
sigil.body: Prove the new number the same way you proved the first. Other devices signed in with the old number will be signed out.
sigil.label: New number
error.auth.phone_taken: That number belongs to another character.
abandon.title: Abandon this character?
abandon.body: In {{days}} days your portraits, letters and bonds are burned. Sign in before then to keep it.
departing.title: Your character will fade
departing.body: In {{days}} days it is gone for good. Sign in any time before then to keep it.
departing.on: Deletion on the {{day}} of the {{month}} moon
departing.banner: This character fades in {{days}} days. Keep it?
offline.road: The road is cut. Letters you write will be sent when it opens.
fault.body: Something broke on this screen. Your letters and bonds are safe.
rest.title: The fire burns low
rest.body: You have sat by it a long while. Rest your eyes — your bonds will keep until you return.
missions.dawnsNone: Light the hearth at dawn to begin
chest.title: Inside the chest
honours.earnedOn: Earned on the {{day}} dawn of the {{month}} moon
honour.sealBreaker.name: Seal-Breaker
honour.sealBreaker.did: Broke the first seal. It is set in your honour case.
honour.sealBreaker.for: Broke the first seal: two strangers spoke until a second portrait was earned.
honour.sealBreaker.line: “Wax is only wax. It is the waiting that is sealed.”
honour.flamekeeper.name: Flamekeeper
honour.flamekeeper.did: Kept the Flame Rite three times. It is set in your honour case.
honour.flamekeeper.for: Lit the Flame Rite three times: three faces met across the glass.
honour.flamekeeper.line: “A fire is only kept by those who come back to it.”
honour.sevenDawns.name: Seven Dawns
honour.sevenDawns.did: Returned seven dawns in a row. It is set in your honour case.
honour.sevenDawns.for: Returned to the hearth seven dawns in a row.
honour.sevenDawns.line: “The sun keeps its word. So did you.”
honour.allyCaller.name: Ally-Caller
honour.allyCaller.did: An ally answered your call. It is set in your honour case.
honour.allyCaller.for: Called a friend through the Gate, and they answered.
honour.trueToWord.name: True to Word
honour.trueToWord.did: Kept five encounters, missing none. It is set in your honour case.
honour.trueToWord.for: Kept five pledged encounters and never left anyone waiting.
honour.trueToWord.line: “A word given is a road walked.”
honour.threadWeaver.name: Thread-Weaver
honour.threadWeaver.did: A thread you wove has sparked. It is set in your honour case.
honour.threadWeaver.for: Wove a thread between two people who both said yes.
honour.threadWeaver.line: “Some fires are lit by a third hand.”
honour.mended.name: Mended
honour.mended.did: A scar has closed. It is set in your honour case.
honour.mended.for: Let a fire go cold once, then kept two encounters and closed the scar.
honour.cartographer.name: Cartographer
honour.cartographer.did: Three districts charted. It is set in your honour case.
honour.cartographer.for: Kept encounters in three districts and charted them.
honour.cartographer.line: “The map is drawn by the feet that walk it.”
honour.bondKeeper.name: Bond-Keeper
honour.bondKeeper.did: Every seal of a bond is broken. It is set in your honour case.
honour.bondKeeper.for: Wrote until every seal of a bond was broken.
honour.oathKeeper.name: Oath-Keeper
honour.oathKeeper.did: Broke the boss’s seal of a Campaign. It is set in your honour case.
honour.oathKeeper.for: Cleared every chamber of a Campaign and broke the boss’s seal with a kept encounter.
honour.oathKeeper.line: “The last door opens from both sides.”
honour.fateSeer.name: Fate-Seer
honour.fateSeer.did: Two yeses at the Town Square. It is set in your honour case.
honour.fateSeer.for: Said yes at the bell, and so did they.
honour.hearthbound.name: Hearthbound
honour.hearthbound.did: You retired together. It is set in your honour case.
honour.hearthbound.for: Retired together and left the hall as a pair.
honour.hearthbound.line: “May the fire you share never die.”
honour.naadam.name: Of the Naadam
honour.naadam.did: Kept an encounter through the Three Games. It returns every summer.
honour.naadam.for: Kept an encounter during the Naadam.
honour.naadam.line: “Strength, aim and speed — and a word kept.”
honour.tsagaanSar.name: Of Tsagaan Sar
honour.tsagaanSar.did: Kept an encounter as the year turned. It returns every year.
honour.tsagaanSar.for: Kept an encounter during Tsagaan Sar.
honour.tsagaanSar.line: “A new moon, and someone to greet it with.”
honour.firstBond.name: First Bond Forged
honour.firstBond.did: Your first bond was forged. It is set in your honour case.
honour.firstBond.for: Forged a first bond with a stranger.
honour.iceBroken.name: Ice Broken
honour.iceBroken.did: The ice broke. It is set in your honour case.
honour.iceBroken.for: Answered the icebreaker, and heard the answer back.
honour.firstTrial.name: First Trial Taken
honour.firstTrial.did: Your first Trial is taken. It is set in your honour case.
honour.firstTrial.for: Took a first Trial with someone.
honour.firstTrial.line: “Five questions, and a little more known.”
honour.tenWords.name: Ten Words Exchanged
honour.tenWords.did: Ten letters in one bond. It is set in your honour case.
honour.tenWords.for: Wrote ten letters in one bond.
honour.tenWords.line: “A letter is a small fire carried far.”
honour.firstPledge.name: First Encounter Pledged
honour.firstPledge.did: Your first meeting is sworn. It is set in your honour case.
honour.firstPledge.for: Swore a first meeting under open sky.
honour.firstPledge.line: “A day, an hour, a place. A promise.”
honour.faceToFlame.name: Face to Flame
honour.faceToFlame.did: Your first Flame Rite is kept. It is set in your honour case.
honour.faceToFlame.for: Met someone face to face across the Flame Rite.
honour.oathFulfilled.name: Oath Fulfilled
honour.oathFulfilled.did: Your oath is proven. It is set in your honour case.
honour.oathFulfilled.for: Proved your oath with kept encounters.
honour.oathFulfilled.line: “Sworn in words, proven on the road.”
hold.atlas: The Hold: seven rooms carved into the mountain
hold.at.longRoad: You are on the Long Road.
hall.intro: {{cohort}}. Carved, not listed. Names are hidden by the rules of the house; only your torch is lit.
hall.unlisted: Your torch is not lit while you rest away from Seek.
hall.retired_one: One pair has retired together and left the hall.
hall.retired_other: {{count}} pairs have retired together and left the hall.
hall.emptyBody: The first to climb will be the first carved.
satchel.sworn: Sworn on the {{day}} dawn of the {{month}} moon
satchel.provenBy: Sworn on the {{day}} dawn of the {{month}} moon · proven by kept encounters
keepsake.dawns_one: One dawn and burning. Never let a fire die.
keepsake.dawns_other: {{count}} dawns and burning. Never let a fire die.
keepsake.label: Your keepsake
keepsake.shareFailed: The keepsake could not be shared. Try again.
keepsake.unavailable: This phone has no way to share a picture.
log.wordNone: No encounter has been counted yet.
log.scarsNone: None. Every silence you owed is answered.
log.scarsOpen_one: One open — two kept encounters close it.
log.scarsOpen_other: {{count}} open — two kept encounters close each one.
log.waypointsNone: No district charted yet. A kept encounter charts its district.
log.seasonHonour: Swear an encounter during {{festival}} and keep it to earn its honour.
log.noShow: They did not come — not your scar
log.disputed: Your answers differed — no one is blamed
log.excused: One of you could not go
log.emptyBody: Pledge a meeting in a bond, keep it, and it is written here.
festival.lastBell: the Last Bell of the Year
error.quest.not_found: That quest is not on today’s board.
error.quest.not_done: That quest is not done yet.
error.chest.not_found: That chest is not in your satchel.
campaign.body: Each deed you do together opens a chamber. Break the boss’s seal with a kept encounter.
campaign.map: The Campaign: the chambers of the Deep
deed.campaignRoom: A chamber of the Campaign was cleared
deed.weeklyTrial: The week’s trial was answered by both
bond.optWeeklyHint: Both answer, both earn — ends Sunday
bond.optRetireHint: Close this bond as complete, and leave the search together
bond.retiredElsewhere: {{name}} retired from the road with someone else. No one is at fault.
weekly.title: The Exchange
weekly.body: This week — {{prompt}} Both answer, both earn.
weekly.hint: {{name}} will not see it until they have answered too.
weekly.sealedBody: It opens when {{name}} answers. The trial ends on Sunday.
games.title: The Three Games
games.body: This week, three small trials for your bond: a test of strength (who gives way in an argument?), of aim (guess their answer), of speed (answer within the hour).
games.strengthQuestion: Who gives way in an argument?
games.iDoHint: I am the first to let it go.
games.speedHint: Once you open it, you have one hour to answer.
games.speedLate: Answered after the hour — this game earns nothing
retire.title: Retire together?
retire.body: You have met and kept your word. Retiring closes this bond as complete and rests both of your characters — you leave the hall together.
retire.askedBody: If you agree, you both leave the search. Your Quest Log keeps this bond as complete.
retire.waitingBody: If they agree, you both leave the search together.
retire.doneBody: The hall keeps your names as hearthbound. May the fire you share never die.
step.weekly.title: This week’s trial
step.weekly.body: Both answer, both earn — ends Sunday.
step.games.title: The Three Games
step.games.body: Three trials for the Naadam week.
error.retire.unavailable: Retiring opens after an encounter you both kept.
error.retire.not_asked: No one has asked to retire.
error.weekly.no_game: This week’s trial has no such game.
error.weekly.closed: This week’s trial has not opened.
weave.title: Weave a thread
weave.body: Two people you know who should meet. Each gets an invitation; neither learns who the other is until both say yes.
weave.hint: Two threads a day. If they match, you earn the Thread-Weaver’s due.
weave.spunBody: Send each their invitation. The code brings a new traveller straight to the thread.
weave.invitation: Someone who knows you thinks you should meet someone on MingldIngl. Neither of you learns who the other is until both say yes. Open the thread: {{link}} (invitation {{code}})
threads.intro: Threads you have woven between two people you know. Neither learns who the other is until both say yes.
threads.emptyBody: Two people you know who should meet — weave them a thread.
thread.title: A thread from {{name}}
thread.body: {{name}} thinks you should meet someone. Neither of you learns who the other is until both say yes.
thread.saidYesBody: If the other says yes too, a bond is made for you both.
ally.title: Call an ally
ally.body: Bring a friend through the Gate. When they prove their number, you both earn a bounty.
ally.message: Come through the Gate with me on MingldIngl — no swiping; speak, keep your word, and the faces are earned. My call: {{code}} {{link}}
character.alliesHint: Call a friend through the Gate
error.threads.self: A thread is for two other people.
error.threads.limit: Two threads a day — weave again tomorrow.
error.threads.not_found: That thread is not yours to answer.
square.sideFull: Your side of the square is full
square.about: Face to face over video, one stranger per round. When the bell rings, each of you decides. Two yeses make a bond.
square.heldBody: {{name}} rings {{day}} at {{time}}. We will call you a minute before.
square.quietBody: No gathering is called yet. The keepers ring the bell a few days ahead.
night.fillingBody: Round {{n}} of {{rounds}} begins when the bell rings. Sit close to the light.
night.sittingOutBody: No one is free at a table this round. Round {{n}} of {{rounds}} begins in {{left}}.
night.question: The question at the bell
night.maskedBody: Faces are earned — tonight, by the sound of a laugh.
night.yesBody: If they say yes too, a bond is made.
night.noBody: They never learn which you chose.
night.decided: Your answer is given. The bell closes in {{left}}.
night.matchBody: A bond is made with {{name}}. The letters wait in your Quest Log.
night.apartBody: The bell rang differently for each of you.
night.closedBody: {{rounds}}, {{bonds}}. The keepers will ring the next bell soon.
night.leaveBody: You will miss the remaining rounds. Your seat goes to no one tonight.
night.lostBody: You are out of the round. Rejoin before the bell and the round goes on.
night.failedBody: The square is full or the bell has already rung for this round.
festival.line.tsagaanSar: A quieter bell, after the family visits. Gentle questions.
festival.line.naadam: The square fills like the stadium. One question from each of the Three Games.
festival.line.lastBell: One more gathering before the year turns. Fireworks overhead.
festival.line.dayOfBond: For those still seeking on the day of bonds. Kind questions.
festival.line.march8: A warm evening in the square.
festival.honour.tsagaanSar: Swear an encounter during Tsagaan Sar and keep it: the honour “Of Tsagaan Sar”. It returns every year.
festival.honour.naadam: The Naadam honour returns every summer.
festival.seekBanner.tsagaanSar: Tsagaan Sar is here. Keep an encounter this season for its honour.
festival.seekBanner.naadam: The Naadam is here. Keep an encounter this season for its honour.
deed.square: You sat at the Town Square
error.square.away: Come back to Seek to take a seat.
error.square.full: Your side of the square is full.
error.square.not_yet: The square opens a little before the first bell.
error.square.no_seat: There is no seat for you tonight.
guild.title: The Guild House
guild.climbBody: Every floor plays the same game and keeps the same word. Higher floors hold more bonds at once and see deeper.
guild.yardGives: A few summons a night, four seats at your fire. The whole game.
guild.hallGives: More summons each night, two more seats at your fire, the deep profile.
guild.highTableGives: Summons to spare, four more seats, the deep profile, first seat at the bells.
guild.renewsPlay: Renews by itself at the same price until you cancel in Google Play, at least a day before it ends.
guild.renewsAppStore: Renews by itself at the same price until you cancel in your App Store settings, at least a day before it ends.
guild.payingBody: We will open {{floor}} the moment it lands.
guild.paidUntil: Paid until {{date}} · it will not renew on its own
guild.sealedBody: Payment is not open yet. Every floor will open soon; the game is the same until then.
guild.failedBody: Nothing was taken. The floors are still here when you are ready.
abandon.paidFloor: {{floor}} goes with it. Cancel its renewal in Google Play; time already paid is not returned.
abandon.paidFloorAppStore: {{floor}} goes with it. Cancel its renewal in the App Store; time already paid is not returned.
error.membership.floor: Choose the Hall or the High Table
error.payments.unavailable: QPay is not answering — try again in a minute
